notes: 'NO está de adorno'. Lessons: varied shots, lower frame busy, physical motion, labels with arrows, hero always in frame.

scenes.title: Esa bolita NO está de adorno
scenes.visual: close on the bead on the cable, a glove taps it; the laptop behind

scenes.title: Enciende y apaga miles de veces
scenes.visual: the charger brick's lid lifts: a blinking chip; red zigzag noise pours into the cable

scenes.title: Se convierte en antena
scenes.visual: wide desk: red rings radiate from the cable; the radio and wifi go to static

scenes.title: Y al revés
scenes.visual: the microwave runs; rings close in on the cable; the laptop screen glitches

scenes.title: Le ponen esta bolita
scenes.visual: side view low on the desk: the bead slides onto the cable

scenes.title: Un cilindro de ferrita
scenes.visual: close: the shell splits open; the dark ferrite cylinder, labelled with an arrow; the cable through the middle

scenes.title: Al ruido le pone un freno
scenes.visual: along the cable: blue current passes, red noise enters the bead and dies; the ferrite glows, heat rises

scenes.title: Un filtro sin chips
scenes.visual: the closed bead orbiting, labelled FERRITA

scenes.title: Calla a tu cable
scenes.visual: wide desk, calm: clean current, radio and wifi fine, camera pulling up
